title: Register state taxes
summary: Register for state income tax, sales tax, and employment tax in operating states. The regimes diverge hard by state: California layers an $800 minimum franchise tax on every registered corporation (law rule us-ca.minimum-franchise-tax), Nevada has no corporate income tax but a gross-receipts commerce tax past $4M of in-state revenue (law rule us-nv.commerce-tax-threshold), and Texas replaces income tax with the margin-based franchise tax (law rule us-tx.franchise-tax-report).

parts.title: Identify required state registrations
parts.guidance: List the company’s state registrations, employee work locations, property, sales and business activities. Have the tax adviser assess income, franchise, withholding, unemployment and sales-tax accounts separately using each relevant agency’s current rules. Record the required account types and effective dates, with missing facts identified. Corporate foreign qualification needs its own assessment; a secretary-of-state registration does not finish tax registration.

execution.rationale: The supported path for “Identify required state registrations” is a person working through the stated digital records, service or communication channel. Retain the named owners, approvals and expert review. This classification does not claim a verified agent integration or imply that future automation is impossible.

parts.title: Register with state tax authority
parts.guidance: Prepare the approved account registration with the correct agency, legal entity, EIN, activity dates, address and contact. Resolve uncertain start dates and complete the declaration and submission through the entity’s authorized filing route. Save the filed application and track agency requests until the account is issued. Store credentials securely and pass the issued account details to the team responsible for its returns or payments.

verify.how: The state issues a tax account number and the registration shows active in the state's portal.

execution.rationale: The documented “Register with state tax authority” work uses digital records, an online service or a remote communication channel and retains its named human owner. Agent assistance does not transfer the human decision, identity or signing responsibility.

parts.title: Register for sales tax (if applicable)
parts.guidance: For states identified in the reviewed sales-tax assessment, check the registration effective date, product treatment and marketplace arrangements. Prepare the applications from those conclusions and the company’s verified details. The authorized filer submits them and tracks issuance. Use the resulting account numbers and filing schedules when configuring collection and returns, with any pending state kept visibly pending.

verify.how: A sales-tax permit number is issued — required before collecting tax in that state.

execution.rationale: The documented “Register for sales tax (if applicable)” work uses digital records, an online service or a remote communication channel and retains its named human owner. Agent assistance does not transfer the human decision, identity or signing responsibility.

parts.title: Store registration numbers
parts.guidance: Enter each issued number with its tax type, jurisdiction, effective date and filing frequency in the restricted compliance register. Attach the agency confirmation and store portal credentials separately. Reconcile issued, pending and rejected applications, then assign notice handling and return preparation to finance or payroll. Give those teams the issued account details needed for their filings.

execution.rationale: The supported path for “Store registration numbers” is a person working through the stated digital records, service or communication channel. Retain the named owners, approvals and expert review. This classification does not claim a verified agent integration or imply that future automation is impossible.

parts.title: Register where you have sales-tax nexus
parts.guidance: Assess each additional state using actual sales, business presence, product treatment and relevant dates. Identify the state rule and measurement period behind the proposed registration. Resolve whether and when to register with the tax adviser before an application is filed. Connect the issued account to billing and return preparation; a platform already collecting elsewhere does not establish this state’s treatment.

execution.rationale: The documented “Register where you have sales-tax nexus” work uses digital records, an online service or a remote communication channel and retains its named human owner. Agent assistance does not transfer the human decision, identity or signing responsibility.

metadata.supportReason: State tax portals have no APIs. System provides state-specific checklists and pre-fills company data.

geoNotes.summary: The state layer is real here: GST registration is per state of operation, and professional tax plus shops-and-establishments registration are state acts — the closest thing to US state tax registration.
No states: registering for taxes means one national HMRC registration each — Corporation Tax (the UTR arrives automatically), PAYE when you employ, and VAT past the £90k threshold.

The sub-national layer is municipal: a Gewerbeanmeldung (trade registration) with each municipality you operate in, which drives Gewerbesteuer at that municipality's Hebesatz — plus the one federal tax-office registration via ELSTER.
Registrations are national and flow from the guichet unique filing; local business taxes (the CFE) are then assessed per commune automatically — nothing to register state-by-state.

One national layer instead of states: the início de atividade declaration with the tax authority covers corporate tax and VAT in one filing, and Segurança Social employer registration is the separate second rail — nothing to repeat per region.

geoNotes.summary: The provincial layer is real: GST/HST is federal via the business number, but BC, Saskatchewan and Manitoba run their own PST registrations, Quebec runs QST, and provinces add payroll levies (Ontario's EHT) and workers'-compensation accounts.
